FIELDS.NAME: Paper & Pen Haven
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Paper & Pen Haven, we operate as a retail stationery store, offering a wide range of paper products and stationery supplies from our physical location as well as through our secure online sales platform. Our core operations include sourcing high-quality stationery items from reputable suppliers, ensuring that we provide our customers with safe and reliable products. We maintain a robust inventory management system, conduct regular stock audits, and offer seasonal promotions to address fluctuating demand. Our team is trained to provide excellent customer service, helping our diverse clientele including schools, businesses, and individuals find exactly what they need. We also have a waste management and recycling program in place to promote environmental responsibility.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss on 03/15/2023 due to a water leak resulting from a faulty roof, resulting in damage to inventory; amount $2,000, currently in the process of filing a claim with the insurance company. Additionally, on 05/01/2023, a minor theft incident occurred resulting in a loss of $1,500, status resolved with security enhancements implemented. Total losses amount to $3,500.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 6 PM, Saturday: 10 AM - 4 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-Resistant Safe, Class B, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with physical security personnel on-site during business hours.

FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – We carry Workers' Compensation insurance as required for our employees, ensuring compliance with state regulations and providing necessary coverage for workplace-related incidents.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – We do not own or operate any other business; Paper & Pen Haven is our sole focus.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – We do not have any other insurance policies with this company beyond the current coverage. Our focus remains on providing a singular insurance solution tailored to our retail operations.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – We do not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations involve retailing stationery products and comply with all safety and regulatory standards. There are no ongoing risks associated with our business model that would lead to catastrophic events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring in our operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are no uncorrected fire code violations at Paper & Pen Haven, and we ensure compliance with all fire safety regulations through regular inspections and maintenance.
